name: @emsenn/flickering.561.group
description: flickering.561.group — a next-generation idle-roguelike on the FizzOS kernel: descend a procedurally generated cave whose play becomes programmable strategy, with an append-only auditable world-trace under traditional and decentralized micropayments.

x-agentic-metro-enterprise.admission: one explicit Flickering server launch with caller-supplied listening, persistence, ledger, and optional payment-provider configuration

serve-flickering-delve.configuration: world/dungeon.json with HOST, FLICKERING_PORT or PORT, optional FLICKERING_SAVE and FLICKERING_LEDGER, plus optional Stripe or Hive provider environment
serve-flickering-delve.returns: a browser-accessible Flickering Delve game service with its sole-writer tick loop and configured persistence
